summary: Frontend Engineer with nearly 4 years of experience designing, developing, and scaling enterprise web applications using React.js, Next.js, TypeScript, and JavaScript (ES6+). Specialized in frontend architecture, reusable component libraries, React Hooks, state management (Redux Toolkit, Zustand, React Query), REST API integration, and performance optimization. Proven track record of improving application performance (1.5× faster load times), building scalable and maintainable solutions, and delivering production-grade applications through responsive design, API caching, code splitting, lazy loading, memoization, and CI/CD in Agile environments.
